exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates; domestic graduates may use board-approved national examinations.
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Board of Medical Examiners and Federation of State Medical Boards)
exams.quote: the applicant has passed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners and the Federation of State Medical Boards, or their successor organizations.

exams.name: Board examination (national examining agency)
exams.notes: In lieu of its own examinations, the board may use examinations prepared, administered, and scored by national examining agencies.
exams.quote: An applicant who fails to achieve a passing grade in the required examinations may request reexamination, and may be reexamined not more than twice at not less than 4-month intervals

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed or certified under this subchapter shall register on or before November 1 of each odd-numbered year following issuance of the license or certificate with the board.

required.quote: each physician shall include with his or her application for a certificate of registration under s. 448.07 proof of attendance at and completion of all of the following: 1. Continuing education programs or courses of study approved for at least 30 hours of credit by the board within the 2 calendar years preceding the calendar year for which the registration is effective.

available.quote: The board may grant a compact license pursuant to the interstate medical licensure compact under s. 448.980.

requirements.value: Reciprocity available via the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (expedited license) or reciprocal credential; for compact, physician must meet eligibility criteria including holding a full unrestricted license in state of principal license, passing USMLE within 3 attempts, completing ACGME-accredited GME, and holding specialty certification recognized by ABMS or AOA.
requirements.quote: The board may grant a compact license pursuant to the interstate medical licensure compact under s. 448.980.

title_protection.quote: no person may use or assume the title "doctor of medicine" or append to the person's name the letters "M.D." unless one of the following applies: 1. The person possesses the degree of doctor of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline for unprofessional conduct after investigation and hearing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall hold a hearing on such conduct... the board may... warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline for negligence in treatment of patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall investigate allegations of unprofessional conduct and negligence in treatment by persons holding a license or certificate granted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may require physical, mental, or professional competency examination if it believes results would be useful in investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may require a person holding a license or certificate to undergo and may consider the results of one or more physical, mental or professional competency examinations if the board believes that the results of any such examinations may be useful to the board in conducting its investigation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to inform patient about alternate treatment modes and risks per s. 448.30 is unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An allegation that a physician has violated s. 253.10 (3), 448.30 or 450.13 (2)... is an allegation of unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to mail or present a medical certification of death within required time periods is unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or has failed to mail or present a medical certification required under s. 69.18 (2) within 21 days after the pronouncement of death... is an allegation of unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a physician to report under s. 448.115 is unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a physician to report as required under s. 448.115.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act by a physician in violation of ch. 450 (pharmacy) or 961 (controlled substances) is unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act by a physician in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may deny a license based on unprofessional conduct, failure to possess required education and training, or failure to achieve passing grade on examinations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny an application for any class of license or certificate and refuse to grant such license or certificate on the basis of unprofessional conduct on the part of the applicant, failure to possess the education and training required for that class of license or certificate for which application is made, or failure to achieve a passing grade in the required examinations.

definition_quote.value: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality; to apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention of any of the conditions described; to penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being; to offer, undertake, attempt or do or hold oneself out in any manner as able to do any of the acts described.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine and surgery" means: (a) To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality. (b) To apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention of any of the conditions described in par. (a) and in sub. (2). (c) To penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being. (d) To offer, undertake, attempt or do or hold oneself out in any manner as able to do any of the acts described in this subsection.

methods_authorized.quote: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality.

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs as part of the practice of medicine and surgery, including issuing prescription orders.
drug_authority.quote: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality.

value: license to practice medicine and surgery
license_status_types.quote: The board may grant licenses, including various classes of temporary licenses, to practice medicine and surgery, to practice as an administrative physician, to practice perfusion, and to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must: (1) hold a diploma from a foreign medical college credentialed by a board-approved agency; (2) obtain ECFMG certification; (3) pass all steps of the USMLE; and (4) complete 24 months of ACGME/AOA-accredited postgraduate training.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery who is a graduate of a foreign medical college must supply evidence satisfactory to the board of all of the following: 1. That the applicant is a graduate of and possesses a diploma from a foreign medical college credentialed by an agency approved by the board. 2. That the applicant has obtained certification by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or a successor organization. 3. That the applicant has passed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant has successfully completed and received credit for 24 months of postgraduate training in one or more programs accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The following compact is hereby ratified and entered into

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: a physician assistant who provides care to patients shall maintain and provide to the board upon request one of the following: a. Evidence that, pursuant to the physician assistant's employment, there is a physician who is primarily responsible for the overall direction and management of the physician assistant's professional activities... b. A written collaborative agreement with a physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies consistent with experience, education, and training, subject to board rules.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a physician assistant may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Information contained in reports filed with the board under s. 49.45 (2) (a) 12r., 50.36 (3) (b), 609.17 or 632.715, or under 42 CFR 1001.2005, shall be investigated by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Within 30 days of receipt of a report under s. 50.36 (3) (c), the board shall notify the licensee, in writing, of the substance of the report.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may promulgate rules specifying a procedure for addressing allegations that a credential holder has practiced while impaired by alcohol or other drugs or that his or her ability to practice is impaired by alcohol or other drugs, and for assisting a credential holder who requests to participate in the procedure.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may grant an administrative physician license to an applicant who satisfies the requirements under s. 448.05 (2c).

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may grant a temporary license to practice medicine and surgery for a period not to exceed 90 days to a nonresident physician who is serving on a full-time or temporary basis in a camp or other recreational facility, or to a physician temporarily maintaining the practice of another physician.
